Every node runs with `use_sim_time: true` and subscribes `/clock`. The image_transport plugin parameters (`compressed`, `theora`, ...) are left out.

#### `/robot_state_publisher`

- **Publishes:** `/robot_description`, `/tf`, `/tf_static`
- **Subscribes:** `/joint_states`

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| `frame_prefix` | `""` |
| `ignore_timestamp` | `false` |
| `publish_frequency` | `20.0` |

|---|---|
| `output_topic` | `"/back_camera/camera/aligned_depth_to_color/image_raw"` |
